observations: Cardboard packaging for a MAXI brand cooker.
Label on the box identifies the model as MAXI 6060 3B+1P INOX.
Model number F6B31G2 is printed on the label in photo 0.
Label specifies features: Lamp, Ignition, Glass Lid, and 1000W Hot Plate.
The box appears slightly worn with some crushing at the corners.
A small reference image of the cooker is visible on the box label.

claims.evidence: Label confirms 'Ignition' and 'Glass Lid' but does not specify a 'glass ignition button'.

claims.claim: oven burner up & down (1 knob control)
claims.evidence: This specific control configuration is not detailed on the external box label.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, used, or damaged unit.
risks.proof: Photo of the actual cooker outside the box.
risks.if_unproven: as a damaged or incorrect item

risks.risk: The electric hotplate or electronic ignition may be faulty.
risks.proof: Video showing the hotplate heating and all gas burners igniting.

risks.risk: Internal oven components like racks or the tray may be missing.
risks.proof: Photo of the open oven showing all accessories.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual cooker out of the box to confirm condition and model.
Photo of the oven interior showing the burners and racks.
Video demonstrating the functionality of the gas burners and the electric hotplate.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified from the manufacturer's label on the box. It is priced at its worst-case condition (non-functional or damaged) until the contents are verified.
